ranked_facts.why: The presence of a prolonged P-wave duration is more characteristic of Advanced Interatrial Block (IAB) with Bayés Syndrome, which is a subtype of Arrhythmogenic Condition, than of other candidate conditions like Valvular Heart Disease or Constrictive Pericarditis.

The finding of irregular narrow complex tachycardia is more indicative of Atrial Fibrillation/Flutter, a type of Arrhythmogenic Condition, and less typical of Supraventricular Tachycardia or Coronary Artery Disease.
